exact_statement.dual_state: The reference state is rho_beta=exp(-beta*(H-min(H)))/Z and the audited dual state is rho_a=W_a*rho_beta*W_a^*. Both are evaluated against K=H-min(H)+I.
exact_statement.moment: The package computes Tr(rho_beta*K^5) and Tr(rho_a*K^5) and checks the finite Markov inequality R^5*Tr(rho*1_[K>R]) <= Tr(rho*K^5) for each declared spectral cutoff R.
exact_statement.kinetic_identity: For the formal scalar momentum shift, (p+a)^2/(2*chi)-p^2/(2*chi)=a*p/chi+a^2/(2*chi). In the matrix fixture this is only a character diagnostic because truncated CCR do not satisfy the infinite-dimensional Weyl relation exactly.
